[P1] Treat a throwing deadline read as no deadline

SDK invariant 4 explicitly requires throwing deadline readings to mean no deadline, as guarded by the execution-context contract tests. This direct call propagates the exception into both factories' step callbacks, where the default retry strategy treats it as permanent. An otherwise valid AI operation therefore fails solely because the platform cannot report remaining time. Catch deadline-reading failures and return no signal, and add coverage using a throwing platform context.
